# Watt Audio

Watt Audio is a mobile app for readers who want to listen to Wattpad stories as audio, create personal chapter audio from supported story links, and keep up with long stories hands-free.

## Primary Pages
- [English homepage](https://wattaudios.com/en/): Product overview and mobile app download links.
- [Vietnamese homepage](https://wattaudios.com/vi/): Tổng quan sản phẩm và link tải app mobile.
- [About Watt Audio](https://wattaudios.com/about.html): Product entity page with features, audience, app description, and download link.
- [Support](https://wattaudios.com/support.html): Quick start, troubleshooting, and contact details.
- [Privacy Policy](https://wattaudios.com/privacy.html): Privacy, local storage, generated audio, and network use.
